summary: Regression + fix-verification pass for Hot Live 95 DJ Playout Studio after 6 stability fixes. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass on the deployed preview URL, including two new regression tests: (1) TestInsertBeforeEmailOrdering — confirms POST /api/admin/keys returns 200 and the key is immediately visible in GET /api/admin/keys (insert-first-then-email is correct), and (2) TestNoDoubleAutoRenew — creates a key with expires_at = now+3d, enables auto_renew (30d), calls POST /api/admin/run-expiry-check, asserts auto_renewed==1 and days_left jumped from ~3 to ~33; a second invocation of run-expiry-check produced NO further change to that key's days_left, verifying process_expiry no longer double-renews after materialising the cursor into a list. owner_email is None and alerts_sent==0 as expected (OWNER_EMAIL empty). Full licensing flow (activate/validate/status/renew/auto-renew/revoke/delete) and admin settings persistence (7/14/30) all pass. Frontend: activation gate renders on fresh load, bypass via localStorage.hotlive95_license unlocks the main DJ studio UI (playlists, transport, jingle bar, My License, Key Manager buttons all present) and it stays STABLE — main-frame navigation count = 1 over 5s (no reload loop). navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().length === 0 and caches.keys().length === 0, confirming the SW remains unregistered in the dev preview. Key Manager opens with passphrase 'hotlive95admin' and the Online dashboard shows stats (Active DJs / Computers Online / Total Keys / Expiring ≤14d), the create form (dj/email/devices/expires + Create), renew-length selector, warn-me selector, and per-row action testids (online-qr-0, online-autorenew-0, online-renew-*, online-resend-*, online-revoke-0, online-delete-0). /live route renders 'Stream link not set yet' notice with no active play control (expected — REACT_APP_STATION_STREAM_URL empty). /license?key= renders. Only console message is the pre-existing benign hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (dev-only, non-blocking). No new console errors, no page-error exceptions, no flashing.

issues: 'Expires' field uses the browser-native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than a shadcn Calendar component — non-blocking cosmetic per review guidelines
Pre-existing React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' in a <select><option> — carried over from iteration_7, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: process_expiry now correctly materialises the cursor via .to_list(length=1000) before mutating expires_at — validated by running run-expiry-check twice: first run auto_renewed==1, second run leaves the just-renewed key untouched.

admin_create_key persists the doc via insert_one BEFORE sending the Resend welcome email, and updates email_sent_at via update_one after — a slow email cannot lose or delay the key; verified with delivered@resend.dev.
index.js service-worker gate (production-only + dev unregister/caches.clear) continues to hold — SW regs=0 and caches=0 in preview.

Frontend ListenLivePage: with no stream URL configured, the play control is not rendered and the 'Stream link not set yet' notice shows — the new error/stalled/ended handlers cannot be exercised in automation without a real stream (agent note acknowledged).
test_credentials: Admin token / Key Manager passphrase: hotlive95admin. Bypass gate: localStorage.hotlive95_license = {activated:true, legalAccepted:true, online:false, key:'QA-KEY', activatedAt:<ISO>}
seed_data_creation: Each new pytest test creates its own key via POST /api/admin/keys and deletes it in a finally block. No residual TEST_ keys left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 stability fixes verified. Backend regression suite (/app/backend/tests/test_licensing.py) now covers: root, admin auth, key create/list, activate/validate/cap, public status, renew/auto-renew/revoke, settings, expiry-check, delete, insert-before-email ordering, and no-double-auto-renew. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_licensing.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. The audio-engine crossfade+duck fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/audioEngine.js CANNOT be verified in headless automation (needs real audio playback across a track change) — do not flag as failure. Frontend flashing/SW-loop is fixed and stable.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verified fixes; no new regressions surfaced. The two backend fixes previously identified (double-renew via live cursor mutation, and welcome-email-before-insert) were both confirmed resolved via targeted tests.
